messages.text:
With line endings corrected, I’m widening the probe set to the reference tests that are most likely to overlap the benchmark: converters, table selection, ranges, and string utilities.

This is the part where the port gets less toy-shaped.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, sys
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
py=[sys.executable,'nushell_port.py']
cases=[
\"('{ \\\"name\\\": \\\"Fred\\\" }' | from json).name\",
\"'{\\\"name\\\": \\\"Fred\\\"}\\n{\\\"name\\\": \\\"Sally\\\"}' | from json -o | get name.1\",
\"[[\\\"a b\\\" \\\"c d\\\"]; [\\\"jim smith\\\" \\\"susie roberts\\\"] [3 4]] | to json -r\",
\"{a: '\\\\', b: 'some text'} | to json -r\",
\"([[lang, gems]; [nu, 100]]).lang | get 0\",
\"let x = [[lang, gems]; [nu, 100]]; "'$x.lang.0",
"[[name, age, grade]; [paul,21,a]] | columns | first",
"[[name, age, grade]; [paul,21,a]] | columns | get 1",
"[[lang, gems, grade]; [nu, 100, a]] | drop column 2 | to json",
"[ { name: ABC, size: 20 }, { name: HIJ } ].size?.1 == null",
"([1, 2, 3] | wrap foo).foo.1",
"[[name, grade]; [Alice, A], [Betty, B]] | get grade.1",
"([[name, age]; [a, 1], [b, 2]]) | select name | get 1 | get name",
"{} | upsert a b | get a",
"[[name,age,grade]; [bill,20,a] [a b c]] | columns | length",
"([{a:1} {a:2} {a:3}] | get foo? | length) == 3",
"([{a:1} {b:2} {a:3}] | get a? | to nuon) == '"'[1, null, 3]'\",
\"[[name, age]; [a, 1] [b, 2]] | get NAmE"'! | select 0 | get 0",
"'"'hello\\r\\nworld' | lines | get 0 | str length\",
\"r#'abcde\\\"\\\"fghi\\\"''''jkl'#\",
\"1..10 | where "'$it > 8 | math sum",
"seq 1 3 | math sum",
]
for c in cases:
    r=subprocess.run([nu,'"'-c',c],capture_output=True)
    p=subprocess.run(py+['-c',c],capture_output=True)
    if (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)"'!=(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr):
        print('"'MISMATCH',c)
        print('REF',r.returncode,r.stdout[:200],r.stderr[:160])
        print('PY ',p.returncode,p.stdout[:200],p.stderr[:160])
'@ | python -"
